list.title: Risk assessment reviews
list.intro: Supplier risk assessments with a part for you to review. You see the general questions and the parts you are responsible for, then pass or return it.
list.countOpen: {count, plural, one {# assessment} other {# assessments}} to review
list.countDone: {count, plural, one {# assessment} other {# assessments}} reviewed
list.emptyOpen: No assessment is waiting for your review right now
list.emptyOpenHint: When procurement sends an assessment with a part for you, it appears here and you are notified.
list.emptyDone: You have not reviewed an assessment yet
list.emptyDoneHint: The assessments you pass or return are listed here.

detail.title: Review a supplier risk assessment
detail.heading: Review assessment {number} · {supplier}
detail.questions: Questions, answers and evidence of your part
detail.questionsHint: This page shows the general part and the parts you review only. The answers of other parts belong to their reviewers.
detail.noQuestions: This assessment has no questions in your part. Decide from what the work is.

source.ON_BEHALF: Filled in by procurement for the supplier

detail.slotsHint: You see the state of the other parts only, not their answers or reasons.

decide.title: Your decision
decide.hint: Pass when the answers and evidence of your part are enough; return when something must be fixed. A review has no rejection.
decide.passTitle: Confirm your part of assessment {number} passes
decide.passBody: When every part passes, the assessment is complete and its risk tier takes effect. A decision cannot be changed.
decide.returnBody: The assessment goes back to be fixed, the other parts of this round not yet decided are cancelled, and procurement is told. A decision cannot be changed.
decide.reasonHint: Say which answer or evidence is missing or wrong. Procurement and the auditors always read it.
decide.share: The supplier may read this message
decide.shareHint: Tick it when the supplier may read these words: they go into the e-mail to the supplier. Unticked, the supplier only learns the assessment was returned.
decide.passedOpen: Your part is recorded as passed. Waiting for the other parts
decide.passedCompleted: Your part is recorded as passed. Every part passed and the assessment is complete
decide.cancelled: This task was cancelled: another part returned the assessment, or the assessment was cancelled.
decide.notDecider: You can read this task but not decide it. Whoever opened or filled in the assessment cannot review it, and acting for a reviewer must still be in effect.
decide.notInReview: This assessment no longer waits for its reviewers, so this task cannot be decided.

errors.FAILED: That did not work. Try again
errors.NO_ANSWER: No answer came back. Press again; the same decision is recorded once only
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again and retry
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not the reviewer of this part, or acting for its reviewer has ended
errors.NOT_FOUND: This review task was not found. Reload the page and check again
errors.MODULE_DISABLED: This organization has not switched on supplier risk
errors.SOD_VIOLATION: You, or the reviewer you act for, opened or filled in this assessment. Whoever prepared it cannot review it; ask your organization's administrator for another reviewer
errors.INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: This task has been decided or closed already. The page now shows where it stands
errors.DECIDED_BY: {name} decided this task at {time}. The page now shows where it stands
errors.REASON: Enter the reason for returning first
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Something is missing or not valid. Check it and try again
errors.CONFLICT_VERSION: Another reviewer decided this assessment at the same moment. Reload the page and check again
